georgina-tamayo.text: Says she made 'significant investments in our fire and police departments, expanding personnel and creating a new Public Park Safety Division,' and secured over $3 million for a new District 1 fire station.

georgina-tamayo.text: Says she attracted major retailers including Tesla, Hobby Lobby, Planet Fitness, Yard House and Round 1, and reinstated the Traffic & Safety Commission.
